title.narrative: INSPIRE (Improving National Systems in Pakistan for Integrated action on Refractive Error)

description.narrative: The project is designed to assist the development of a comprehensive approach to strengthen refractive and optical services in Pakistan. It will make a significant contribution to the effective scaling up of screening, refractive services, provision of eyeglass and strengthening the integration of these approaches into government-led national programmes. The overall goal of the project is to improve access to sustainable refractive and optical services at the primary level of health care in Pakistan.
